description: This source file defines an interface IEventHubQueueCacheFactory for creating EventHub partition message caches within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It specifies a method CreateCache for instantiating cache objects with given partition identifiers, checkpointers, and logger factories.

classes.name: IEventHubQueueCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating EventHub partition message caches.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Creates an instance of IEventHubQueueCache for a specified partition, checkpointer, and logger factory.
